plan.subject: Atrial fibrillation treatment

queries.query: ("catheter ablation" OR "pulmonary vein isolation" OR "cryoballoon ablation" OR "radiofrequency ablation") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Catches the main rhythm-control procedural literature on contemporary AF ablation techniques and comparative outcomes.

queries.query: ("persistent atrial fibrillation" OR "long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation" OR "non-paroxysmal atrial fibrillation") AND ("catheter ablation" OR "substrate modification" OR "posterior wall isolation" OR "linear ablation")
queries.rationale: Targets the harder clinical subgroup where lesion-set strategy and efficacy questions differ from paroxysmal AF.

queries.query: ("first-line ablation" OR "initial rhythm control" OR "early rhythm control" OR "early ablation") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Finds trials and major studies on whether earlier rhythm-control intervention improves outcomes versus delayed treatment.

queries.query: ("rate control" OR "rhythm control" OR "lenient rate control" OR "strict rate control") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Captures the long-running management debate most relevant to everyday treatment pathway decisions.

queries.query: ("direct oral anticoagulant" OR DOAC OR apixaban OR rivaroxaban OR dabigatran OR edoxaban) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Covers the core anticoagulation evidence base including drug-specific AF studies and comparative effectiveness papers.

queries.query: ("major bleeding" OR "intracranial hemorrhage" OR "gastrointestinal bleeding" OR "bleeding risk") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib OR anticoagulation OR DOAC)
queries.rationale: Targets clinically actionable safety evidence on hemorrhagic complications that influences anticoagulant selection.

queries.query: ("left atrial appendage closure" OR "left atrial appendage occlusion" OR Watchman OR Amulet) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Finds device-based stroke-prevention studies relevant to patients who are poor long-term anticoagulation candidates.

queries.query: ("stroke prevention" OR thromboembolism OR "systemic embolism") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib OR anticoagulation OR "left atrial appendage closure")
queries.rationale: Surfaces the endpoint literature most central to treatment decisions across drugs and device strategies.

queries.query: ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib) AND (guideline OR guidelines OR "consensus statement" OR "practice guideline")
queries.rationale: Captures society guidance and formal consensus documents that distill evidence into bottom-line clinical recommendations.

queries.query: ("randomized trial" OR "randomized controlled trial" OR "clinical trial" OR registry OR "meta-analysis") AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib OR "catheter ablation" OR DOAC)
queries.rationale: Provides a recall-safety sweep for the evidence formats this reader prefers without drifting into basic science.

queries.query: ("antiarrhythmic drug" OR amiodarone OR flecainide OR dronedarone OR sotalol) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Covers pharmacologic rhythm-control options and comparative treatment studies that remain central in clinical practice.

queries.query: ("heart failure" OR HFrEF OR HFpEF) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib OR "catheter ablation" OR "rhythm control")
queries.rationale: Targets a major comorbidity subgroup where rhythm-control choices and outcome benefits may differ materially.

queries.query: ("electrical cardioversion" OR "pharmacologic cardioversion" OR cardioversion) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Finds evidence on acute rhythm restoration approaches and peri-cardioversion management relevant to frontline care.

queries.query: ("repeat ablation" OR redo ablation OR "ablation recurrence" OR "atrial fibrillation recurrence") AND ("catheter ablation" OR "pulmonary vein isolation")
queries.rationale: Captures studies on durability, recurrence patterns, and when repeat intervention improves outcomes.

queries.query: ("pulse field ablation" OR "pulsed field ablation" OR electroporation) AND ("atrial fibrillation" OR AFib)
queries.rationale: Targets one of the fastest-moving procedural innovations with immediate relevance for electrophysiology practice.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan emphasizes clinically actionable AF treatment evidence across catheter ablation, rhythm-vs-rate strategy, anticoagulation, bleeding, stroke prevention, appendage closure, antiarrhythmic drugs, cardioversion, heart failure subgroup management, guidelines, and trial-level evidence. It deliberately avoids basic electrophysiology mechanisms, animal work, genetics, and economics-focused searches because the profile is strongly treatment- and decision-oriented. I included both focused procedural/drug queries and a few broader evidence-format sweeps to improve recall for major trials, registries, and guideline updates.
